title: Verify: resolveTextureKey unit tests
summary: Unit tests for resolveTextureKey fallback behavior.
description: Write tests from the REQ2 spec using an in-memory manifest only.
acceptance_criteria: Known, unknown and undefined ids are asserted
technical_constraints: Use the literal fallback id 'fallback:missing' in the tests, to match FALLBACK_ASSET_ID in src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts

steps.action: Create the test file with a manifest that holds one asset with id 'A'. Add test 'known' expecting resolveTextureKey('A', manifest, 'fallback:missing') to equal 'A'. Add test 'unknown' expecting resolveTextureKey('nope', manifest, 'fallback:missing') to equal 'fallback:missing'. Add test 'undefined' expecting resolveTextureKey(undefined, manifest, 'fallback:missing') to equal 'fallback:missing'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/resolveTextureKey.test.ts
